messages.content: You are operating autonomously inside a deterministic simulation. Preserve the mission goal and current authoritative checkpoint across the entire growing transcript. At each turn choose the single best next action from the scenario's allowed actions. Return ONLY one JSON object with keys action, checkpoint, rationale, state. action and checkpoint must be strings. rationale may be concise; state may contain your compact working state. Never declare COMPLETE before the environment says all required verification is satisfied.

SCENARIO adaptive_project_plan: Drive a multi-step project toward the objective while minimizing wasted work. Adapt when an authoritative constraint invalidates part of the plan. Initial authoritative checkpoint=PLAN-A. Allowed actions: DECOMPOSE, PRIORITIZE, SCHEDULE, REPLAN, RECOVER, OPTIMIZE, VERIFY, COMPLETE.
TURN 1/8. ENVIRONMENT: The objective has four dependent workstreams and no execution order yet. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 2/8. ENVIRONMENT: Dependencies are known; identify the work that unlocks the most downstream progress. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 3/8. ENVIRONMENT: Priorities are accepted. Build an executable order that respects dependencies. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 4/8. ENVIRONMENT: AUTHORITATIVE UPDATE: checkpoint is now PLAN-B. A key resource disappears, invalidating two scheduled steps. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 5/8. ENVIRONMENT: A substitute resource exists but requires changing the middle of the plan while preserving completed work. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 6/8. ENVIRONMENT: The recovered plan is feasible; reduce unnecessary steps without violating constraints. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 7/8. ENVIRONMENT: The optimized plan is ready. Verify every original and updated constraint before completion. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
TURN 8/8. ENVIRONMENT: Verification confirms all dependencies, updates, and success criteria are satisfied. Choose the best next autonomous action now.
